user.title: Connect to a seat
user.description: The address of a seat you run (cliffvm) and a token for it. On the seat's machine, mint the token with `cliffvm token mint --sub ha --name "Home Assistant" --ttl 30d --secret-file <seat folder>/door.secret` and paste it here. See docs/home-assistant.md.

reauth_confirm.title: The seat needs a new token
reauth_confirm.description: The seat at {url} refused Home Assistant's token (it ran out, or the seat's key changed), or this entry has no seat yet. Mint a new one on the seat (`cliffvm token mint --sub ha --ttl 30d --secret-file <seat folder>/door.secret`) and paste it here.

error.cannot_connect: The seat didn't answer at that address.
error.invalid_auth: The seat refused the token (wrong, expired, or from another seat).
error.invalid_url: That is not an http:// or https:// address.
